Học phần trang bị các kiến thức liên qua: The course covers statistical methods for evaluating data, including the concepts of statistical distributions, estimation of the mean and standard deviation, goodness-of-fit testing of a statistical hypothesis, the Monte Carlo method, the maximum-likelihood method for estimating the parameters of a problem, fitting of experimental data, regression and correlation analysis, and time-series analysis. The course equips students with methods for evaluating data in radiation measurement.
Học phần cung cấp Học phần cung cấp một: The course presents several nuclear techniques important for measuring the activity of radionuclides in the environment, in order to build a database for radiation-safety assessment. It covers the application of nuclear techniques in geophysical and hydrological radiometric surveying, and the study of the natural radiation field emitted by rocks or water for geological mapping, prospecting for radioactive ores or non-radioactive ores associated with radioactive elements, and the study of the geological water environment.
Học phần “Công nghệ đóng gói nâng cao” l: The course “Advanced Packaging Technology” builds on the disciplinary course “Semiconductor Packaging Technology” and gives students advanced knowledge of semiconductor device packaging. Packaging technologies are covered in advanced detail, including ch
LED, công nghệ đóng gói Laser bán dẫn, c: LED packaging, semiconductor laser packaging, solar-cell packaging, integrated-circuit packaging and thermoelectric device packaging. Besides packaging at the component level, packaging at the system level is also introduced in this course.
Lý thuyết: Sinh viên sẽ được trang bị đầ: Theory: students acquire a full grounding in risk-assessment procedures, hazard identification and the corrective measures used when operating equipment.
Thực hành: Sinh viên được trang bị kỹ nă: Practice: students develop practical skills in drafting operating procedures and emergency-response procedures, and in carrying out risk and hazard assessments.
Chuyển động của mặt trời và vấn đề đo th: Motion of the sun and the measurement of time: calendars, mean solar time, sidereal time, zone time.
Các hành tinh trong hệ mặt trời, sự hình: The planets of the solar system: their formation and properties, inner and outer planets, and their satellites.
Sự phát triển của các ngôi sao, biểu đồ: Stellar evolution, the H-R diagram, stellar classification, dwarfs, giants and supergiants.
Môn học trang bị kiến thức về kiểm tra c: The course covers semiconductor testing, both theory and practice, aimed at ensuring the stable operation of VLSI (Very Large Scale Integration) chips. Topics include: 1) understanding device characteristics; 2) planning testing during chip design so that all operating scenarios are covered; 3) hardware requirements.
Môn học này cung cấp kiến thức liên quan: This course covers the role of renewable energy sources, energy-conversion materials (light to electricity) and the various types of solar cell.
Python là ngôn ngữ được sử dụng rộng rãi: Python is widely used in many fields, particularly in scientific and engineering research. The course covers Python programming from basic to advanced level. On completion, students will be able to apply Python programming skills in their study and research.
Giới thiệu chung về khái niệm, lịch sử p: General introduction to the concept, historical development and applications of the GPR method.
Vận hành được các thiết bị ra đa xuyên đ: Operate IDS and Zond12e ground-penetrating radar systems for field surveys.
Môn học này cung cấp các kiến thức liên: This course covers microelectromechanical systems and microstructure fabrication methods such as lithography, bulk micromachining, LIGA technology and device packaging. It also covers the fabrication of electronic devices based on the micromachining methods studied.
Môn học được dạy ở học kỳ 6. Nội dung mô: The course is taught in semester 6. It covers the basic concepts of electrical circuits, methods for analysing linear circuits in the DC and sinusoidal steady state, and methods for analysing linear circuits in the transient state. Students need prior knowledge of linear differential equations, the Laplace transform and the basic laws of electromagnetism.
Cung cấp kiến thức tổng quát cho sinh vi: Gives students a general knowledge of the complete fabrication process for a semiconductor device and of process control. Students also carry out one or more steps of a device fabrication process in the laboratory, so as to understand the experimental work and verify the theory they have studied.
Học phần “Quản lý nhiệt cho các linh kiệ: The course “Thermal Management for Electronic Components” equips students with fundamental knowledge
truyền nhiệt, các cơ chế cơ bản của truy: heat transfer and its basic mechanisms, thermal convection and thermal radiation. Starting from a general thermal model, students build specific thermal models to identify the basic factors affecting a device's thermal behaviour: thermal conductivity, geometry, internal heat sources and external heat sources. Both steady-state and transient thermal models are introduced. Applications of thermal models to the thermal management of electronic components: ch
p điốt phát quang, linh kiện pin mặt trờ: p, light-emitting diodes, solar cells, thermoelectric generators (TEG), thermoelectric coolers (TEC) and IC chips. Several applications and solutions for mitigating thermal damage are also presented: thermal-protection circuits, packaging materials that reduce heat accumulation, and active and passive cooling technologies. A solid grasp of “Thermal Management for Electronic Components” enables graduates, engineers and researchers to apply and develop thermal models in order to study and optimise device performance and extend device lifetime, giving them a firm foundation for a career in semiconductor technology.
Học phần “ Mô hình linh kiện bán dẫn” tr: The course “Semiconductor Device Modelling” gives students a foundation in modelling, from basic concepts to the purpose of a model. It covers chip-related modelling, the interaction of electromagnetic waves with semiconductors, modelling of light-emitting semiconductors, models of light-emitting semiconductor sources, and colour-uniformity models for devices
, mô hình phổ phát xạ của linh kiện bán: , and emission-spectrum models of light-emitting semiconductor devices. Alongside the theoretical foundation that allows students to understand, analyse, evaluate and apply the material, the course includes practical work on selected models so that students can build the knowledge, skills and attitudes needed for their future careers.
Các kỹ thuật mô phỏng như VASP (Gói mô p: Simulation techniques such as VASP (Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package) and Quantum ESPRESSO play a central role in semiconductor materials science, allowing these materials to be simulated at the atomic and electronic level. They are of the first importance because they let researchers and students explore and understand the fundamental properties and behaviour of semiconductor materials, clarifying the electronic structure, band-gap characteristics and basic quantum phenomena that determine their electrical properties. Using these simulation tools, students gain invaluable insight into the inner workings of semiconductors; that insight in turn allows semiconductor manufacturers to design and optimise devices such as transistors, solar cells and LEDs with greater precision.
Ôn tập kiến thức về ngôn ngữ lập trình M: Review of the Matlab programming language: students apply Matlab to simulate thermodynamic processes in plasma systems.
Lý thuyết: Sinh viên được trang bị các k: Theory: students study gas-discharge plasma systems, the types of collision occurring in them, and the motion and collisions of charged particles and atoms in a DC magnetron sputtering system, and formulate models of these processes.
Thực hành 1: Tính toán các phân bố nhiệt: Practice 1: computing the thermodynamic distributions of a particle system, computing the mean free path, and determining the quantities that characterise transport processes such as molecular diffusion, momentum diffusion and energy diffusion.
Thực hành 2: Mô phỏng các mô hình chuyển: Practice 2: simulating models of motion and collision in plasma and of thin-film deposition.
Môn học này nằm trong nội dung chương tr: This course belongs to the curriculum on semiconductor simulation and its applications. The theory is taught to the whole class, while practical work is done in groups.
Môn học trang bị cho học viên những kiến: The course gives students foundational and advanced knowledge of energy-band theory in solids. It presents methods for computing the band structure of materials and discusses their physical properties in terms of that band structure. Representative band structures of semiconductors such as Si and GaAs are examined in detail. Students also learn to apply the tight-binding model to compute the band structure of simple semiconductors.
Hiểu mạng thần kinh nhân tạo (ANN). Từ d: Understand artificial neural networks (ANN) and combine semiconductor manufacturing with the power of artificial intelligence to optimise and improve production processes.
Vận dụng kỹ thuật lập trình và mô hình m: Apply programming techniques and simulation models to the growth processes of semiconductor thin films.
Môn học này cung cấp cho sinh viên những: This course covers the design flow for VLSI (Very Large-Scale Integration) circuits and the electrical characteristics of each circuit element. Students learn the physical-design flow and its direct effect on circuit performance, area, reliability, power and manufacturing yield, and apply the basic principles of CMOS logic to integrated-circuit design. The main steps of the VLSI design flow are covered, with emphasis on physical design: partitioning, chip planning, placement, clock network synthesis, routing and timing closure. Physical verification ensures the logical and electrical correctness of the VLSI circuit, including Design Rule Check (DRC) and Layout Versus Schematic (LVS).
Mục tiêu của học phần này nhằm trang bị: This course equips students with the fundamentals of logic design, the families of programmable logic devices and the Verilog HDL hardware description language. On completion, students should master techniques for designing complex digital circuits using programmable logic devices (FPGA, CPLD) and be able to analyse, design and build a reasonably complete hardware system.
Môn học này nhằm cung cấp cho sinh viên: This course provides specialised knowledge of semiconductor materials and their applications. It covers band structure in semiconductors and their optical properties (absorption and emission processes). Optical methods used to study semiconductors are introduced, including transmission, reflection and photoluminescence. The photoelectric properties of several important semiconductors are examined, together with typical optoelectronic devices such as diodes, photodiodes and transistors. The course also familiarises students with forming and working in groups and with giving presentations, building a firm foundation in semiconductor materials and improving the presentation skills they will need for their thesis work.
Môn học này cung cấp cho sinh viên kiến: This course provides in-depth knowledge of the advanced materials used in semiconductor memory devices, together with the operating principles and the parameters that affect device performance. It also develops students' device fabrication and analysis skills and their evaluative and critical thinking, and their ability to find, understand and select the information relevant to the subject.
Môn học này nhằm cung cấp cho sinh viên: This course provides specialised knowledge of the interaction of electrons and photons with matter and of the signals emitted from a sample that are used in analytical methods. Students learn the construction, operating principle and application of each specific method for determining sample properties: UV-VIS for absorption, transmission, reflection and band gap of semiconductors; PL for band structure and impurity levels in nanomaterials; STM and AFM for surface properties and quantum arrangement; SEM and TEM for morphology and impurity composition; XRD for crystallinity; the Hall method for conductivity, carrier concentration and mobility in semiconductors; and XPS for bonding and impurity composition. The course also familiarises students with specialist English terminology, with reading international papers, and with group formation, teamwork, presentation, discussion and effective critical thinking, building a firm foundation for genuine research in their graduation thesis.
Lý thuyết: Sinh viên sẽ được trang bị đầ: Theory: students acquire a full grounding in nanomaterials for SERS sensor applications, in molecular spectroscopy — Raman and infrared — and in spectral processing.
Thực hành: Sinh viên được trang bị kỹ nă: Practice: students develop practical skills in fabricating semiconductor nanomaterials for SERS and in measuring and processing Raman spectra.
Môn học này nằm trong nội dung chương tr: This course belongs to the curriculum on the fabrication of semiconductor nanomaterials and their applications. The theory is taught to the whole class, while practical work is done in groups.
Môn học trang bị cho sinh viên các kiến: The course covers the structure, operating principles and applications of lighting devices from basic to advanced — LEDs, OLEDs, lasers, solar cells — and of optical sensing systems, optical communications, and optical signal detection, processing and amplification. Students are also introduced to “Green Photonics”: energy-efficient lighting technology that draws on renewable energy, reduces greenhouse-gas emissions and limits environmental pollution. In particular, students encounter laser cutting and engraving and ion-beam techniques, basic tools of the semiconductor industry. Ion-beam applications include surface cleaning, film deposition, impurity implantation, nanodevice bonding and integrated-circuit repair. The course belongs to the “Energy, storage and display engineering” strand of the semiconductor technology programme. Students experience active teaching methods, group discussion, and both group and individual work.
Học phần cung cấp các kiến thức liên qua: The course covers the types of defect found in semiconductor materials, the effect of defects on the properties of semiconductor materials and devices, and the methods used to identify defects in them.
Môn học cung cấp những kiến thức về cấu: The course covers the band structure of semiconductors and the energy structure of metal–semiconductor, semiconductor–semiconductor and semiconductor–electrolyte interfaces. It describes charge- and mass-transfer processes at contact boundaries according to Marcus and Gerischer theory, and presents the mechanism of light-energy conversion in photoelectrochemical systems. The course introduces and practises basic experimental techniques in semiconductor electrochemistry, such as band-gap measurement, current–voltage characterisation and electrochemical impedance measurement.
Học phần trang bị cho người học các nguy: The course equips learners with the basic principles of 2D and 3D display technology (the human visual system, colour perception and depth perception, colour theory and measurement, and modern display technology), with display evaluation and performance calibration, and with the latest display research. It is suitable for both undergraduate and postgraduate students.
Môn học cung cấp cho sinh viên những kiế: The course gives students an overview of semiconductor technologies and their applications. Learners study both foundational and modern semiconductor technologies, and also learn about the University's semiconductor research groups and the laboratories associated with them.
Ứng dụng công nghệ bức xạ trong vật liệu: Radiation Technology Applications in Semiconductor Materials is a specialisation course that builds on and extends general and disciplinary foundations, combined with the use of radiation technology in semiconductor materials. It covers (i) the characteristics of radiation, (ii) the interaction and effects of radiation on materials, and (iii) the application of radiation technology to the modification, synthesis, analysis and characterisation of semiconductor materials.
Lý thuyết: Sinh viên được trang bị các k: Theory: students study the design of fuel-cell systems and energy-storage systems and master the processes taking place inside them.
Thực hành: Tổng hợp một hệ màng vật liệu: Practice: synthesising a material film system for Li-ion batteries and assembling a Li-ion battery; studying the operation and simulation of hydrogen fuel cells and microbial fuel cells.
Môn học này nằm trong nội dung chương tr: This course belongs to the curriculum on semiconductors and their applications. The theory is taught to the whole class, while practical work is done in groups.
Đây là môn học hướng dẫn tổng quát cho s: This course is a general introduction to research and development methods, including how to search for, read, analyse and synthesise literature. Students then independently investigate, write and present a topic requiring research and development in a seminar on a specific subject.
Sinh viên sẽ được học qua 2 phần: phần m: Students take the course in two parts: in the first, all students study research and development methods together; in the second, each student is assigned a specific topic and gives a seminar on it under the guidance of a supervisor. Reference material is normally in English, so as to strengthen students' specialist English.
Môn học trang bị cho sinh viên kiến thức: The course gives students an overview of development, sustainable development and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), together with the current situation, opportunities, challenges and some solutions for meeting those goals. It also develops the basic skills students need to search for, select, organise and share knowledge and information on scientific and social issues, so that they can apply what they learn to form opinions, judgements and decisions oriented towards sustainable development.
Môn học giới thiệu các kiến thức cơ bản: The course introduces the basics of crystal lattice structure, the types of bonding in crystals, and the thermal properties of solids and semiconductors, comprising the following main parts:
Các cấu trúc cơ bản của mạng tinh thể, m: Basic crystal lattice structures, the reciprocal lattice and bonding in crystals.
Môn học trang bị cho sinh viên các kiến: The course gives students the foundational and specialised knowledge needed to understand how semiconductor devices work, including carrier generation and transport in semiconductor materials and the structure and operation of typical diodes and transistors.
Môn học giới thiệu các kiến thức cơ bản: The course introduces the basic mechanical, thermal, electrical and optical properties of intrinsic, lightly doped and heavily doped semiconductors, covering the following:
Phần cơ cung cấp cho sinh viên những kiế: The mechanical part gives students basic and more advanced knowledge of defects in solids and of the mechanical properties of solids and semiconductors.
Phần nhiệt cung cấp cho sinh viên những: The thermal part covers the thermal vibrations of the crystal lattice of solids.
Phần quang trang bị các kiến thức chuyên: The optical part provides specialised knowledge of the optical properties of solids in general and of semiconductors in particular.
Cuối cùng là giới thiệu cho sinh viên bi: Finally, students are introduced to the density of states and electron localisation in semiconductors.
Môn học giới thiệu quy trình sản xuất ch: The course introduces the manufacturing processes for various semiconductor electronic devices such as solar cells and sensors. The main processes are photolithography, silicon fabrication, ion implantation, chemical vapour deposition and physical vapour deposition. The relationship between the performance of these two device types and the fabrication process is also covered.
Bài giảng bắt đầu với thiết kế phòng sạc: The lectures begin with basic cleanroom design, cleanroom classification standards, the various sources of contamination, and airflow and air filtration in cleanrooms. Different types of cleanroom are discussed, with a focus on semiconductor and nanotechnology applications. Chemical handling and laboratory safety are addressed in the context of practical cleanroom exercises.
Trong phần thứ hai và quan trọng nhất củ: The second and most important part of the lectures covers in detail the various lithography-based methods of nanofabrication. This knowledge is then applied directly in the practical sessions.
Tiếng Việt: Môn học này giới thiệu các h: Vietnamese: This course introduces the basic logic functions, components and methods used in digital system design. Digital electronics topics include basic logic gates, Boolean algebra, number systems, combinational logic circuits, multiplexers, decoders, flip-flops and registers. Digital system applications include counters, magnitude comparators, ADC and DAC conversion, feedback control, sensor interfacing and signal conditioning. The course requires students to work in groups to propose ideas, carry out a course project and give a group presentation.
Môn học này cung cấp cho sinh viên kiến: This course gives students the basics of measurement and measuring instruments and of determining the measurement error introduced by an instrument. Students learn the construction and operation of DC and AC measuring instruments (for voltage, current, resistance, capacitance, inductance and power), and acquire the knowledge and practical skills related to Hall measurement, the four-point probe method, null ellipsometry, optical-microscope inspection and other modern inspection methods.
Học phần “Công nghệ đóng gói linh kiện b: The course “Semiconductor Packaging Technology” gives students an overview of semiconductor device packaging, of packaging materials, and of the physical phenomena affecting packaging performance. Packaging technologies covered include ch
p LED, Công nghệ đóng gói Laser bán dẫn,: p LED packaging, semiconductor laser packaging, solar-cell packaging, integrated-circuit packaging and thermoelectric device packaging. Besides the component level, packaging at the system level is also introduced.

Design of a simple microprocessor comprising an arithmetic logic unit (ALU) and a control unit. Semiconductor physics fundamentals; the structure and operating principles of the MOSFET; MOSFET amplifier circuits such as common source (CS) and common gate (CG); CMOS logic circuits and the calculation of switching points.
Môn học có vai trò quan trọng trong việc: The course plays an important part in equipping students with the knowledge and thinking tools of innovation, helping them form ideas, assess feasibility and turn knowledge into practical products or services.
Khóa học này nhằm mục đích cung cấp cho: This course aims to give senior students an understanding of the global challenges in integrated coastal zone management (ICZM) and to equip them with the knowledge and skills to develop effective strategies for sustainable coastal development. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, case studies and practical exercises, students analyse and evaluate the various aspects of ICZM.
Nội dung gồm có các quá trình vật lý, hó: The content covers the physical, chemical and biological processes occurring in the ocean. The basic concepts and properties of these processes and their practical applications help learners understand and adapt to human impacts on the ocean, the biosphere and the atmosphere.
Học phần này giới thiệu về các phương ph: The course introduces weather-forecasting methods and common weather patterns, and takes the first steps in using numerical models for atmospheric simulation and in analysing numerical forecast results.
Môn học bao gồm các chuyên đề về hải dươ: The course comprises topics in oceanography, meteorology, hydrology and the environment, helping students acquire the knowledge and skills needed to solve a specific problem in their professional work and to keep up with current information on real-world topics. It combines theory, field practice and computational modelling.
Ngày nay, với sự phát triển mạnh mẽ của: Today, with the rapid advance of science and technology, modelling tools appear in every field of society. For long-established fundamental sciences such as Earth Science, using modelling tools to capture, simulate and forecast part of the workings of nature is essential. The course “Applied Hydrodynamic Models in Earth Science” therefore introduces students to modern computational tools for calculating and forecasting the dynamic factors of rivers, seas and oceans, and to tools for meteorology in general and agricultural meteorology in particular.
Nội dung chủ yếu tập trung vào các phần: The content focuses on: describing an algorithm with a flowchart for a specific programming requirement; writing and running source code for that algorithm in C/C++ to produce the required product; and organising a (small-scale) program so that it is maintainable, extensible and reusable.
Học phần này cung cấp kiến thức chuyên s: The course provides in-depth knowledge of medical imaging methods, including ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Students study the operating principles, how the equipment is operated, and the process of acquiring and analysing medical images. On completion, students can apply imaging methods to identify pathologies in the body, and develop skills in independent and team work, self-study and self-directed research, effective communication and problem solving.
